name: add_affected_user
description: add_affected_user: Add an employee to the affected users list of an existing outage ticket. Used when a caller reports an outage that has already been logged, to avoid creating a duplicate ticket.

ticket_number.description: The existing outage ticket number (e.g. INC0048271).

employee_id.description: The employee reporting the same outage (e.g. EMP048271).
